name: among us live action
design:
A cinematic sci-fi environment in a highly realistic, live-action style, inspired by the Among Us universe.
Scene:
interior of a futuristic spaceship corridor with large panoramic windows facing outer space, showing a massive glowing alien jellyfish-like organism drifting outside
Character fidelity (CRITICAL):
characters are realistic interpretations of Among Us crewmates
maintain iconic Among Us silhouette (rounded body, compact proportions)
humanoid astronaut suits (realistic proportions allowed)
smooth, rounded helmet with large glossy visor
backpack integrated as life-support system
no cartoon simplification
no exaggerated proportions
suits must feel functional and believable
high-end sci-fi spacesuit design (NASA-inspired but stylized)
Helmet / Visor (VERY IMPORTANT):
large curved glass visor
highly reflective surface
reflections of environment and glowing alien creature visible
subtle light bloom from outside source
slightly tinted glass (dark but reflective)
cinematic specular highlights
Composition:
cinematic framing (film shot style)
shallow depth of field
strong foreground / midground / background separation
over-the-shoulder shot OR side profile close-up
characters looking toward the window or interacting with environment
camera positioned slightly behind or beside characters
natural human camera perspective (NOT isometric)
Characters:
2~4 crewmates (yellow, red, purple, cyan)
wearing realistic suits
standing, observing, or interacting (e.g. touching glass, wiring panel, reacting)
natural posture and weight distribution
no stiff posing
Environment:
realistic spaceship interior
metallic walls with soft reflections
panel seams, vents, cables, and modular structures
soft indirect lighting from ceiling panels
large viewing window showing space
clean but detailed sci-fi production design
Alien creature (KEY ELEMENT):
massive bioluminescent jellyfish-like entity
floating in space outside the window
glowing gradient colors (cyan, blue, magenta, purple)
semi-transparent body
soft organic motion feel
light emission affects surrounding environment subtly
tentacles drifting slowly
scale should feel enormous compared to ship
Lighting:
cinematic lighting (NOT flat)
soft global illumination
strong contrast between dark interior and glowing exterior
subtle rim light on characters
light bounce from alien creature
volumetric softness (very subtle)
Color:
realistic color grading
slightly desaturated base tones
strong accent colors from alien glow
no flat fills
no cartoon palette
Material / Surface quality:
realistic materials (metal, glass, fabric)
soft reflections
subtle roughness variation
no texture noise exaggeration
no painterly effect
Depth:
real lens depth of field
slight background blur
foreground elements slightly out of focus when needed
cinematic focus pull feel
Style:
ultra high-quality cinematic sci-fi
live-action movie still
realistic rendering (Unreal Engine / film production level)
NOT illustration
NOT cartoon
NOT vector
Avoid:
flat shading
thick outlines
cartoon style
Among Us 2D look
exaggerated proportions
plastic look
low detail
noisy textures
over-sharpening
